Name: Melons to Watermelons
Author: zynonia
Description:
This mod will replace the growing stages of the melons, the harvested icon, and the seed pouch appearance.  If I missed any melons, let me know!  It'll help if you can track down the .xnb file that I'd need to edit.

[u]Installation[/u]
Copy the springobjects.xnb to Content>Maps and replace the old file that was there.
Copy the crops.xnb to Content>TileSheets and replace the old file that was there.

I'd recommend making a backup of your content folder before installing any mods, just in case you want to undo them.

This mod is not compatible with any other mods that change these files, but you are free to edit the file yourself to mix mods together, or add it to a compilation mod if you'd like.

[u]Bugs
[/u]This mod does not replace the melon in the starting screen.  I have yet to track down this melon in the files.  If you know where it is, let me know and I'll fix it!
